mapper.select:
SELECT (CASE WHEN ISDATE(WO.접수일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, WO.접수일자) , 126) ELSE WO.접수일자 END) AS W_RCEPTDE , WO.일련번호 AS W_SN , RTRIM(IC.품목코드) AS IC_CODE , RTRIM(IC.품목명) AS IC_NM , RTRIM(IC.규격) AS IC_STNDRD , WO.단가 AS W_UNTPC , (CASE WHEN ISDATE(WO.접수일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, WO.접수일자) , 126) ELSE WO.접수일자 END) AS W_ORDERDE , (CASE WHEN ISDATE(WO.납기일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, WO.납기일자) , 126) ELSE WO.납기일자 END) AS W_DEDT , WO.수량 AS W_QUANTITY , WO.그룹수량 AS W_GRP_QY , WO.낱개수량 AS W_PIECE_QY , WO.거래처재고중량 AS W_C_INVSTTUS , WO.단가단위문자 AS W_UNIT_CHRCTR , WO.단가 AS W_NEWUNITPC , WO.합계금액 AS W_SUMAMOUNT , WO.착지업체 AS W_ALOCENTRPS , WO.주문비고 AS W_NOTE , WO.중량 AS W_WT , IC.단위당수량 AS IC_UNITQY , (CASE IC.포장단위 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.포장단위 END) AS IC_PACKNGUNIT , (SELECT RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.거래처코드 = WO.착지업체 AND CM2.등록사업장 = WO.출고사업장) AS DLVYENTRPSNM , IC.업체전용구분 AS IC_ENT_DVR_SE , IC.생산구분 AS IC_PRDCTN_SE , COUNT(WO.납기일자) OVER (PARTITION BY WO.착지업체, WO.납기일자) AS CO , SUM(WO.중량) OVER (PARTITION BY WO.착지업체, WO.납기일자) AS QYSM , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY WO.착지업체, WO.납기일자 ORDER BY WO.착지업체 DESC, WO.납기일자, RTRIM(IC.품목명)) AS GRP_DTNUMBER , SUM(WO.합계금액) OVER (PARTITION BY WO.착지업체, WO.납기일자) AS AM
, DBO.웹_재고중량_함수(WO.납기일자, RTRIM(IC.품목코드), 'C', WO.접수일자, WO.일련번호) AS INVNTRY_QY , DATEDIFF(DAY, GETDATE(), WO.납기일자) AS DATE_DIFF
ORDER BY WO.착지업체 DESC, WO.납기일자, RTRIM(IC.품목명)

SELECT DISTINCT WO.착지업체 AS W_ALOCENTRPS , (SELECT RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.거래처코드 = WO.착지업체 AND CM2.등록사업장 = WO.출고사업장) AS DLVY_ENTRPS_NM
ORDER BY WO.착지업체
mapper.sql:
FROM 웹주문접수 WO JOIN 단가변동 UPC WITH(NOLOCK) ON(WO.단가사업장 = UPC.사업장 AND WO.거래처코드 = UPC.거래처코드 AND WO.품목코드 = UPC.품목코드 AND UPC.변경일자 = (SELECT MAX(UPC2.변경일자) FROM 단가변동 UPC2 WHERE UPC.사업장 = UPC2.사업장 AND UPC.품목코드 = UPC2.품목코드 AND UPC.거래처코드 = UPC2.거래처코드 AND UPC2.변경일자 <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),getdate(),112)) )
JOIN 품목코드 IC WITH(NOLOCK) ON (UPC.사업장 = IC.사업장 AND UPC.품목코드 = IC.품목코드)
